Class BuildState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.states.State
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.states.BuildState
public class BuildState extends State
Represents the Build phase in the game's state machine where players construct their ships. Implements specific logic and restrictions for this state.
